look: Crate Mimic, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Hoard Mimics family: supply crate mimic with too many teeth and a sticky tongue. Family anatomy: mimics disguised as crates, chests and vault doors with toothy lids and sticky tongues. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are gold-flecked citrine crystal. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Neutral: weathered brown, iron grey and brass accents, small subtle dust motes and glinting coins
